newsitem.title: USA: Mcgraw-Hill names promotes Jack Witmer.
newsitem.headline: Mcgraw-Hill names promotes Jack Witmer.

text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos said Monday Jack E. Witmer was named president of its Educational and Professional Publishing Group, which includes the Educational Publishing, Higher Education and Consumer, and Professional Publishing groups.
The company said Witmer succeeds Peter Jovanovich, who resigned to join Pearson Plc as chairman and CEO of Addison Wesley Longman Inc.

"Jack Witmer's remarkable record of success as president of Glencoe/McGraw-Hill and since May 1996 as president of our Educational Publishing Group makes him extremely well prepared to assume the leadership of this important business segment," said Joseph L. Dionne, chief executive of McGraw-Hill.
